plans.idea: Classic left-to-right banner read: brand lockup, then the bottle with its NEW badge beside it, then a full-width headline with legal tucked beneath, ending on a generously sized CTA anchored right.

Message-first strip: the headline leads at the far left with legal underneath, the product and badge sit in the middle as the visual pivot, and the CTA plus the logo as a brand sign-off close the strip on the right.

Logo opens, a full-height headline column gets maximum type size, the bottle with its NEW flag sits between message and action, and the CTA is stacked over the legal line as one tidy action block on the right.
